The '''Biomedical Research Station''' was a part of the [[Polis Massa Research Base]]. The Station was used to attempt to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] extinct [[Species/Legends|species]] and also stored data on cloning techniques from the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
